audience: Codex plugin UI builders and Control Plane operators
candidate_text: Codex `plugin/read` now exposes `PluginDetail.shareUrl` for remote plugins, including admin-disabled global plugins, while keeping existing `shareContext` semantics. Practical for copy-link plugin UIs. PR: https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/27890
caveats: Do not imply disabled remote plugins become installable.
Keep shareUrl separate from shareContext in public wording.

claims.text: PluginDetail now carries nullable shareUrl for remote plugins.
The existing shareContext semantics remain separate from the remote canonical share URL.

decision.reason: The change has a concrete user-facing copy-link explanation for remote plugin UI consumers.

evidence_notes: Remote plugin detail maps upstream share_url through.
Plugin read tests cover admin-disabled remote plugin share URLs.
next_steps: Let Publisher automation decide whether to reserve or publish this candidate.
